# Xcelsior — LLM-Optimized Documentation
# https://xcelsior.ca
# Per Report #1.B: "Standard llms.txt for AI agents"
# See https://llmstxt.org for specification

> Xcelsior is a distributed GPU compute marketplace for AI/ML workloads where
> independent hosts compete on price. Rent GPUs by the hour (on-demand or spot),
> or run serverless inference billed per token. Every capability is reachable
> three ways: the REST API, a hosted MCP server, and an in-app AI assistant.

## Overview

Xcelsior aggregates consumer and data-center GPUs into a managed compute
marketplace. Providers register GPU hosts; submitters run inference and
training jobs. The platform handles scheduling, billing, SLA enforcement,
artifact storage, and trust/reputation scoring.

**Stack**: Python 3.12, FastAPI, PostgreSQL 16 (primary), SQLite (auxiliary),
Headscale (mesh networking), Docker + gVisor (container isolation).

**Pricing**: Quoted and settled in CAD. Spot capacity is materially cheaper than
on-demand for checkpointable workloads. Serverless inference is billed per
million tokens with no idle cost.

**Regions and residency**: Placement is region-aware. Workloads with a data
residency or jurisdiction requirement pass that constraint explicitly and the
scheduler enforces it — including province-level filtering and PIPEDA / Quebec
Law 25 / BC FIPPA / Ontario PHIPA constraints where those apply. Residency is a
per-workload option, not a platform-wide restriction.

## Three ways to drive the platform

| Surface | Best for | Entry point |
|---|---|---|
| **REST API** | scripts, CI, your own backend | `https://xcelsior.ca` · `/openapi.json` |
| **Xcelsior MCP** | external agents — Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, any MCP client | `/mcp` |
| **Xcel AI** | in-app, no setup — chat in the dashboard | `/dashboard/ai` |

MCP and Xcel AI expose comparable capability. Use MCP when the agent lives
outside Xcelsior; use Xcel AI when you want the same power with nothing to
install.

## Xcelsior MCP (AI Agents)

Hosted Model Context Protocol server for Cursor, Claude, and other agents:

- Endpoint: `https://xcelsior.ca/mcp` (Streamable HTTP)
- Health: `GET https://xcelsior.ca/mcp/health`
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <oauth_access_token>` (create client at `/api/oauth/clients`)
- Scopes: `instances:read`, `instances:write`, `billing:read`, `gpu:read`, `marketplace:read`, or `api`
- Tools: discovery, compute (`create_instance`, `watch_instance`), billing, guardrails (`should_i_run_this`), serverless, workflows
- Resources: `xcelsior://docs/llms`, `xcelsior://pricing/reference`
- Stdio: `npx @xcelsior-gpu/mcp` with `XCELSIOR_ACCESS_TOKEN`
- Setup: https://xcelsior.ca/mcp

## Xcel AI (In-App Assistant)

Xcel is a tool-calling assistant built into the dashboard at `/dashboard/ai`. It
drives the platform in natural language with no client, no key, and no config —
the same class of capability as the MCP server, for users who are already signed in.

**What it can do** — 34 tools across the full product surface:

| Area | Tools |
|---|---|
| Compute | `launch_job`, `stop_job`, `list_jobs`, `get_job_details`, `get_host_status` |
| Discovery | `recommend_gpu`, `get_gpu_availability`, `search_marketplace`, `get_benchmarks`, `get_spot_price_history` |
| Cost | `estimate_cost`, `get_pricing`, `get_billing_summary`, `get_billing_cycles`, `get_invoices`, `get_wallet_transactions`, `get_crypto_deposits` |
| Storage | `list_volumes`, `list_checkpoints` |
| Serverless | `get_inference_endpoints` |
| Credentials | `create_api_key`, `list_api_keys`, `revoke_api_key`, `add_ssh_key`, `get_ssh_keys` |
| Provider side | `get_provider_info`, `get_payout_history`, `get_reputation`, `get_sla_status`, `get_sla_terms` |
| Account | `get_account_info`, `get_team_info`, `get_notifications`, `search_docs` |

**Write actions require explicit confirmation.** Any tool that spends money,
launches compute, or mints a credential returns a pending confirmation rather than
executing. The user approves it, and only then does it run. Confirmations are
signed, single-use, bound to the requesting user, and expire.

Endpoints:
- `POST /api/ai/chat` — send a message; returns the reply plus any tool calls made
- `POST /api/ai/confirm` — approve or reject a pending write action
- `GET /api/ai/suggestions` — context-aware next-step prompts
- `GET /api/ai/conversations` · `GET /api/ai/conversations/{id}` — conversation history
- `GET /api/ai/analytics` — assistant usage stats

Support chat (RAG over product documentation, separate from the tool-calling assistant):
- `POST /api/chat` · `GET /api/chat/suggestions` · `GET /api/chat/history/{conversation_id}`
- `GET /api/chat/conversations` · `POST /api/chat/feedback`

## Onboarding Wizard (CLI)

Interactive terminal wizard for host registration and SDK setup, guided by Hexara:

```
npx @xcelsior-gpu/wizard@latest
```

Requires Node.js ≥ 18. No global install. Steps: API reachability check → host
registration → worker install → SDK detect → SDK install → credentials → verify.
Covers both sides — bringing a GPU online as a provider, and wiring the SDK into
your own project as a consumer.

## API Base URL

- Production: `https://xcelsior.ca`
- Development: `http://localhost:8000`

## Authentication

All non-public endpoints require a Bearer token:

```
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

Bearer auth can use a user API key, an OAuth user access token, or an OAuth machine token.

Public endpoints (no auth): `/`, `/docs`, `/openapi.json`, `/dashboard`,
`/healthz`, `/readyz`, `/metrics`, `/api/stream`, `/api/transparency/report`.

## Core Endpoints

### Hosts
- `PUT /host` — Register/update a GPU host (admission-gated)
- `GET /hosts` — List hosts (query: `active_only`)
- `DELETE /host/{host_id}` — Remove a host

### Instances (Jobs)
- `POST /instance` — Submit an instance (fields: name, vram_needed_gb, gpu_model, pricing_mode, git_repo, init_script)
- `GET /instances` — List instances
- `GET /instance/{job_id}` — Get instance details
- `GET /api/instances/{job_id}/telemetry` — GPU telemetry for running instance
- `POST /instances/{job_id}/cancel` — Cancel instance
- `POST /queue/process` — Trigger scheduler allocation

### Spot Pricing
- `GET /spot-prices` — Current spot pricing per GPU model
- `POST /instance` with `pricing_mode: "spot"` — Submit interruptible spot instance
- `POST /spot/preemption-cycle` — Run preemption on underbid jobs

### Marketplace
- `POST /marketplace/list` — List a rig for rent
- `GET /marketplace` — Browse available rigs
- `DELETE /marketplace/{host_id}` — Unlist a rig

### Billing (v2.1)
- `GET /api/billing/wallet/{customer_id}` — Wallet balance
- `POST /api/billing/wallet/{customer_id}/deposit` — Add credits (CAD)
- `GET /api/billing/invoice/{customer_id}` — Generate invoice with tax
- `POST /api/billing/refund` — Process refund (host-side failures = full refund)

### Artifacts
- `POST /api/artifacts/upload` — Get presigned upload URL (B2/R2/local)
- `POST /api/artifacts/download` — Get presigned download URL
- `GET /api/artifacts/{job_id}` — List job artifacts

### Reputation & Trust
- `GET /api/reputation/{entity_id}` — Trust score and tier
- `GET /api/reputation/leaderboard` — Top providers
- `POST /api/reputation/verify` — Submit verification (email/phone/gov_id/incorporation)

### Verification
- `POST /api/verify/{host_id}` — Run hardware verification checks
- `GET /api/verified-hosts` — List verified hosts with scores

### SLA
- `POST /api/sla/enforce` — Run monthly SLA enforcement for a host
- `GET /api/sla/{host_id}` — Get SLA record and uptime percentage
- `GET /api/sla/violations/{host_id}` — Violation history
- `GET /api/sla/downtimes` — Active downtime periods

### Provider Onboarding (Stripe Connect)
- `POST /api/providers/register` — Create provider account (company name, BN, email)
- `GET /api/providers/{provider_id}` — Provider details
- `POST /api/providers/{provider_id}/incorporation` — Link incorporation file
- `POST /api/providers/webhook` — Stripe webhook handler

### Jurisdiction & Compliance
- `POST /api/jurisdiction/hosts` — Filter hosts by jurisdiction constraints
- `GET /api/compliance/provinces` — Province compliance matrix
- `GET /api/compliance/tax-rates` — GST/HST rates by province
- `POST /api/compliance/quebec-pia-check` — Quebec Law 25 PIA check

### Privacy (PIPEDA)
- `POST /api/privacy/config` — Set org privacy config (privacy officer, retention)
- `POST /api/privacy/consent` — Record consent
- `DELETE /api/privacy/consent/{entity_id}/{consent_type}` — Revoke consent
- `GET /api/privacy/retention-policies` — View retention policies

### Telemetry
- `POST /agent/telemetry` — GPU telemetry push (utilization, temp, memory, power)
- `GET /api/telemetry/all` — All hosts' latest telemetry
- `GET /api/stream` — SSE event stream (real-time updates)

### Health
- `GET /healthz` — Liveness probe
- `GET /readyz` — Readiness probe (checks DB + storage)
- `GET /metrics` — Prometheus-style metrics snapshot

### Serverless Inference (autoscaling GPU endpoints)
Management API (session auth):
- `GET /api/v2/serverless/enabled` — Feature flag probe
- `POST /api/v2/serverless/endpoints` — Create endpoint (preset vLLM or custom Docker)
- `GET /api/v2/serverless/endpoints` — List endpoints
- `GET /api/v2/serverless/endpoints/{id}/health` — Worker health
- `GET /api/v2/serverless/endpoints/{id}/usage` — Metrics and cost
- `POST /api/v2/serverless/endpoints/{id}/keys` — Issue per-endpoint API key (`xcel_` prefix)

Job API (per-endpoint key or session):
- `POST /v1/serverless/{id}/run` — Async enqueue → `{id, status: IN_QUEUE}`
- `POST /v1/serverless/{id}/runsync` — Sync wait (timeout bounded)
- `GET /v1/serverless/{id}/status/{job_id}` — Poll status/output
- `GET /v1/serverless/{id}/stream/{job_id}` — SSE token stream
- `POST /v1/serverless/{id}/cancel/{job_id}` — Cancel job

OpenAI-compatible (change base_url + key):
- `POST /v1/serverless/{id}/openai/v1/chat/completions` — Chat (streaming SSE supported)
- `GET /v1/serverless/{id}/openai/v1/models` — List models

Legacy aliases: `/api/v2/inference/endpoints/*` → same handlers.

OpenAI SDK example:
```python
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(
    base_url="https://xcelsior.ca/v1/serverless/{endpoint_id}/openai/v1",
    api_key="xcel_...",
)
```

TypeScript SDK: `client.serverless.createEndpoint()`, `.runJob()`, `.chatCompletions()`.

### OpenAPI (client-facing)
- `GET /openapi.json` — Curated public spec (~70 paths, 79 operations). Internal/admin routes excluded.
- Full Fern source: `fern/openapi.json` (regenerate via `python3 scripts/generate_public_openapi.py`).

## Data Models

### HostIn (PUT /host)
```json
{
  "host_id": "gpu-001",
  "ip": "10.0.0.5",
  "gpu_model": "RTX 4090",
  "total_vram_gb": 24.0,
  "free_vram_gb": 24.0,
  "cost_per_hour": 0.45,
  "country": "CA",
  "province": "ON",
  "versions": {"runc": "1.2.4", "nvidia_ctk": "1.17.8", "nvidia_driver": "570.0", "docker": "27.0.0"}
}
```

### JobIn (POST /job)
```json
{
  "name": "llama-finetune",
  "vram_needed_gb": 20.0,
  "priority": 5,
  "tier": "sovereign"
}
```

### Provider Registration (POST /api/providers/register)
```json
{
  "provider_id": "provider-acme",
  "email": "admin@acme.ca",
  "provider_type": "company",
  "corporation_name": "ACME Computing Inc.",
  "business_number": "123456789RC0001",
  "gst_hst_number": "123456789RT0001",
  "province": "ON"
}
```

## Trust Tiers

| Tier | Uptime SLA | Use Case |
|------|-----------|----------|
| community | 99.0% | R&D, experimentation |
| secure | 99.5% | Production inference |
| sovereign | 99.9% | Government, regulated data |

## Reputation Tiers

| Tier | Score | Perks |
|------|-------|-------|
| Bronze | 0-299 | Baseline access |
| Silver | 300-599 | Priority payouts, 1.1x visibility |
| Gold | 600-899 | Verified badge, 1.25x visibility |
| Platinum | 900+ | Reduced platform fee, 1.5x visibility |

## Sales Tax (applies to Canadian customers)

Rates returned by `GET /api/compliance/tax-rates`.

| Province | Rate |
|----------|------|
| ON | 13% HST |
| QC | 14.975% (GST+QST) |
| BC | 12% (GST+PST) |
| AB | 5% GST |
| Atlantic | 15% HST |

## Error Format

All errors follow a consistent envelope:

```json
{
  "ok": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "unauthorized",
    "message": "Unauthorized"
  }
}
```

Common codes: `unauthorized` (401), `rate_limited` (429), `validation_error` (422),
`http_error` (4xx/5xx).
